19810-my-a-ntonia.title: My A Ntonia
19810-my-a-ntonia.creator: Willa Sibert Cather
19810-my-a-ntonia.description: A book by Willa Sibert Cather. go we were under the protection of a friendly passenger conductor, who knew all about the country to which we were going and gave us a great deal of advice in exchange for our confidence. He seemed to us an experienced and worldly man who had been almost everywhere; in his conversation he threw out lightly the names of distant States and cities.

arxiv-1801-04387.title: The Problem of Correlation and Substitution in SPARQL —Extended Version—
arxiv-1801-04387.creator: Daniel Hernández, Claudio Gutierrez, Renzo Angles
arxiv-1801-04387.description: Abstract Implementations of a standard language are expected to give same outputs to identical queries. In this paper we study why different implementations of SPARQL (Fuseki, Virtuoso, Blazegraph and rdf4j) behave differently when evaluating queries with correlated variables. We show that at the core of this problem lies the historically troubling notion of logical substitution.

arxiv-1807-04774.title: New full evolutionary sequences of H and He atmosphere massive white dwarf stars using MESA 2018 New full evolutionary sequences of H and He atmosphere massive white dwarf stars using MESA – 18
arxiv-1807-04774.creator: G.R. Lauffer, A. D. Romero, S.O. Kepler
arxiv-1807-04774.description: Abstract We explore the evolution of hydrogen-rich and hydrogen-deficient white dwarf stars with masses between 1.012 1.012 and 1.307 1.307 M ⊙ , and initial metallicity of Z = 0.02 Z=0.02 . These sequences are the result of main sequence stars with masses between 8.8 8.8 and 11.8 11.8 M ⊙ .

arxiv-2011-12122.title: Modeling gravitational waves from exotic compact objects
arxiv-2011-12122.creator: Alexandre Toubiana, Stanislav Babak, Enrico Barausse, Luis Lehner
arxiv-2011-12122.description: Abstract Exotic compact objects can be difficult to distinguish from black holes in the inspiral phase of the binaries observed by gravitational-wave detectors, but significant differences may be present in the merger and post-merger signal. We introduce a toy model capturing the salient features of binaries of exotic compact objects with compactness below 0.2 0.

arxiv-2102-01264.title: Evaluating the Interpretability of Generative Models by Interactive Reconstruction Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 8–13, 2021; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’21), May 8–13, 2021, Yokohama, Japan Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.11
arxiv-2102-01264.creator: Andrew Slavin Ross, Nina Chen, Elisa Zhao Hang, Elena L. Glassman, Finale Doshi-Velez
arxiv-2102-01264.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrew Slavin Ross, Nina Chen, Elisa Zhao Hang, Elena L. Glassman, Finale Doshi-Velez. For machine learning models to be most useful in numerous sociotechnical systems, many have argued that they must be human-interpretable. However, despite increasing interest in interpretability, there remains no firm consensus on how to measure it. This is especially true in representation learning, where interpretability research has focused on “disentanglement” measures only applicable to synthetic datasets and not grounded in human factors.

arxiv-2202-06280.title: On the complexity of All ε \varepsilon -Best Arms Identification
arxiv-2202-06280.creator: Aymen Al Marjani, Tomas Kocak, Aurélien Garivier
arxiv-2202-06280.description: Abstract We consider the question introduced by [ MJTN20 ] of identifying all the ε \varepsilon -optimal arms in a finite stochastic multi-armed bandit with Gaussian rewards. We give two lower bounds on the sample complexity of any algorithm solving the problem with a confidence at least 1 − δ 1-\delta .

arxiv-2204-10986.title: Regrets of Proximal Method of Multipliers for Online Non-convex Optimization with Long Term Constraints
arxiv-2204-10986.creator: Liwei Zhang, Haoyang Liu, Xiantao Xiao
arxiv-2204-10986.description: Abstract The online optimization problem with non-convex loss functions over a closed convex set, coupled with a set of inequality (possibly non-convex) constraints is a challenging online learning problem. A proximal method of multipliers with quadratic approximations (named as OPMM) is presented to solve this online non-convex optimization with long term constraints.

arxiv-2208-05746.title: Electron magnetic moment of transient chiral phonons in KTaO 3
arxiv-2208-05746.creator: R. Matthias Geilhufe, Wolfram Hergert
arxiv-2208-05746.description: Abstract High intensity THz lasers allow for the coherent excitation of individual phonon modes. The ultrafast control of emergent magnetism by means of phonons opens up new tuning mechanisms for functional materials. While theoretically predicted phonon magnetic moments are tiny, recent experiments hint towards a significant magnetization in various materials.

arxiv-2209-14275.title: Audio Retrieval with WavText5K and CLAP Training
arxiv-2209-14275.creator: Soham Deshmukh, Benjamin Elizalde, Huaming Wang
arxiv-2209-14275.description: Abstract Audio-Text retrieval takes a natural language query to retrieve relevant audio files in a database. Conversely, Text-Audio retrieval takes an audio file as a query to retrieve relevant natural language descriptions. Most of the literature train retrieval systems with one audio captioning dataset, but evaluating the benefit of training with multiple datasets is underexplored.

arxiv-2304-12440.title: Two Decreasing Measures for Simply Typed λ \lambda -Terms (Extended Version)
arxiv-2304-12440.creator: Pablo Barenbaum, Cristian Sottile
arxiv-2304-12440.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pablo Barenbaum, Cristian Sottile. This paper defines two decreasing measures for terms of the simply typed λ \lambda -calculus, called the 𝒲 \mathcal{W} -measure and the 𝒯 𝐦 \mathcal{T}^{\mathbf{m}} -measure. A decreasing measure is a function that maps each typable λ \lambda -term to an element of a well-founded ordering, in such a way that contracting any β \beta -redex decreases the value of the function, entailing strong normalization.

arxiv-2402-16658.title: Multi-Objective Learning for Deformable Image Registration
arxiv-2402-16658.creator: Monika Grewal 1, Henrike Westerveld 2, Peter A. N. Bosman 1,3, Tanja Alderliesten 4
arxiv-2402-16658.description: Abstract Deformable image registration (DIR) involves optimization of multiple conflicting objectives, however, not many existing DIR algorithms are multi-objective (MO). Further, while there has been progress in the design of deep learning algorithms for DIR, there is no work in the direction of MO DIR using deep learning.

arxiv-2405-05709.title: On the Capacity of Correlated MIMO Phase-Noise Channels: An Electro-Optic Frequency Comb Example
arxiv-2405-05709.creator: Mohammad Farsi, Hamdi Joudeh, Gabriele Liga, Alex Alvarado, Magnus Karlsson, Erik Agrell
arxiv-2405-05709.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Farsi, Hamdi Joudeh, Gabriele Liga, Alex Alvarado, Magnus Karlsson, Erik Agrell. The capacity of a discrete-time multiple-input-multiple-output channel with correlated phase noises is investigated. In particular, the electro-optic frequency comb system is considered, where the phase noise of each channel is a combination of two independent Wiener phase-noise sources. Capacity upper and lower bounds are derived for this channel and are compared with lower bounds obtained by numerically evaluating the achievable information rates using quadrature amplitude modulation constellations.

arxiv-2411-00734.title: Multi-layer Dataflow: Orchestrate Butterfly Sparsity to Accelerate Attention Computation
arxiv-2411-00734.creator: Haibin Wu 1 , Wenming Li 1,∗ , Kai Yan 1,∗ , Zhihua Fan 1,∗ , Peiyang Wu 1 , Yuqun Liu 1 , Yanhuan Liu 1 , Ziqing Qiang 1 , Meng Wu 1 , Kunming Zhang 1 , Xiaochun Ye 1 , Dongrui Fan 1
arxiv-2411-00734.description: Abstract Recent neural networks (NNs) with self attention exhibits competitiveness across different AI domains, but the essential attention mechanism brings massive computation and memory demands. To this end, various sparsity patterns are introduced to reduce the quadratic computation complexity, among which the structured butterfly sparsity has been proven efficient in computation reduction while maintaining model accuracy.

arxiv-2501-01151.title: Characteristic oscillations in frequency-resolved heat dissipation of linear time-delayed Langevin systems: Approach from the violation of the fluctuation response relation
arxiv-2501-01151.creator: Xin Wang, Ruicheng Bao, Naruo Ohga
arxiv-2501-01151.description: Abstract Time-delayed effects are widely present in nature, often accompanied by distinctive nonequilibrium features, such as net heat flow from a single thermal bath to the system. To elucidate detailed structures of the dissipation, we study the frequency decomposition of the heat dissipation in linear time-delayed Langevin systems.

arxiv-2506-11852.title: 3D Skin Segmentation Methods in Medical Imaging: A Comparison Thanks: Citation : Authors. Title. Pages…. DOI:000000/11111.
arxiv-2506-11852.creator: Martina Paccini, Giuseppe Patané
arxiv-2506-11852.description: Abstract Automatic segmentation of anatomical structures is critical in medical image analysis, aiding diagnostics and treatment planning. Skin segmentation plays a key role in registering and visualising multimodal imaging data. 3D skin segmentation enables applications in personalised medicine, surgical planning, and remote monitoring, offering realistic patient models for treatment simulation, procedural visualisation, and continuous condition tracking.

arxiv-2510-06127.title: Towards Autonomous Tape Handling for Robotic Wound Redressing
arxiv-2510-06127.creator: Xiao Liang, Lu Shen, Peihan Zhang, Soofiyan Atar, Florian Richter, Michael Yip
arxiv-2510-06127.description: Abstract Chronic wounds, such as diabetic, pressure, and venous ulcers, affect over 6.5 million patients in the United States alone and generate an annual cost exceeding $25 billion. Despite this burden, chronic wound care remains a routine yet manual process performed exclusively by trained clinicians due to its critical safety demands.

arxiv-2510-20905.title: Global Dynamics of Heavy-Tailed SGDs in Nonconvex Loss Landscape: Characterization and Control
arxiv-2510-20905.creator: Xingyu Wang, Chang-Han Rhee
arxiv-2510-20905.description: Abstract Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants enable modern artificial intelligence. However, theoretical understanding lags far behind their empirical success. It is widely believed that SGD has a curious ability to avoid sharp local minima in the loss landscape, which are associated with poor generalization.

arxiv-2601-05264.title: Engineering the RAG Stack: A Comprehensive Review of the Architecture and Trust Frameworks for Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
arxiv-2601-05264.creator: Dean Wampler, Ph.D
arxiv-2601-05264.description: Abstract This article provides a comprehensive systematic literature review of academic studies, industrial applications, and real-world deployments from 2018 to 2025, providing a practical guide and detailed overview of modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. RAG offers a modular approach for integrating external knowledge without increasing the capacity of the model as LLM systems expand.

arxiv-2602-14764.title: Pulsar based modeling of point spread function of Fermi Large Area Telescope
arxiv-2602-14764.creator: Jeffrey Blunier 1, Andrii Neronov 1,2, Dmitri Semikoz 1
arxiv-2602-14764.description: Abstract Context. Sensitivity of searches for extended emission around gamma-ray sources is naturally limited by the precision of the knowledge of the Point Spread Function (PSF) of gamma-ray telescopes. Inaccuracies in the PSF models of the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) can potentially lead to false positive detections of source extension. Aims.

arxiv-2602-20925.title: LST-SLAM: A Stereo Thermal SLAM System for Kilometer-Scale Dynamic Environments
arxiv-2602-20925.creator: Zeyu Jiang, Kuan Xu, Changhao Chen
arxiv-2602-20925.description: Abstract Thermal cameras offer strong potential for robot perception under challenging illumination and weather conditions. However, thermal Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) remains difficult due to unreliable feature extraction, unstable motion tracking, and inconsistent global pose and map construction, particularly in dynamic large-scale outdoor environments.

britannica-1911-baillie-robert-scottish-.title: Baillie, Robert (Scottish divine) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)

britannica-1911-cremera.title: Cremera (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cremera.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cremera.description: Article 'Cremera' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Etruria which falls into the Tiber about 6 m. The identification with the Fosso della Valchetta is fixed as correct by the account in Livy ii. 49, which shows that the Saxa Rubra were not far off, and this we know to be the Roman name of the post station of Prima Porta, about 7 m.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-columbus.title: Columbus (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-columbus.creator: Lawrence Mulhane
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-columbus.description: Article 'Columbus' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-11382415.title: Identification of diagnostic candidates in Mendelian disorders using an RNA sequencing-centric approach
pmc-11382415.creator: Carolina Jaramillo Oquendo, Htoo A Wai, Wil I Rich, David J Bunyan, N Simon Thomas, David Hunt, Jenny Lord, Andrew G L Douglas, Diana Baralle
pmc-11382415.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundRNA sequencing (RNA-seq) is increasingly being used as a complementary tool to DNA sequencing in diagnostics where DNA analysis has been uninformative. RNA-seq enables the identification of aberrant splicing and aberrant gene expression, improving the interpretation of variants of unknown significance (VUSs), and provides the opportunity to scan the transcriptome for aberrant splicing and expression in relevant genes that may be the cause of a patient’s phenotype.

pmc-11506844.title: Chinese Herbal Medicines as Natural Alternative Products to Antibiotics in Weaned Piglets through Intestinal Microbiota Regulation
pmc-11506844.creator: Che-Hsuan Wang, Kou-Toung Chung, Li-Yu Su, Wan-Jhen Wu, Pei-Hwa Wang, Ming-Chung Lee, Szu-Chuan Shen, Chung-Hsin Wu, Bernhard Biersack
pmc-11506844.description: During the growth process of weaned piglets, digestive problems such as gastrointestinal disorders and diarrhea are common. Farmers usually use antibiotics to help piglets grow smoothly. However, the overuse of antibiotics can lead to antibiotic resistance issues. Therefore, this study chose to use plant extracts as feed additives to explore their potential as alternatives to antibiotics.

pmc-11570830.title: Tubular glycogen accumulation in acute kidney injury associated with red yeast rice supplement
pmc-11570830.creator: Reina Miyazaki, Yasuhito Takahashi, Yuri Katayama, Tetsuya Kawamura, Nobuo Tsuboi, Takashi Yokoo
pmc-11570830.description: oides contaminates the cultivation of red yeast rice and produces puberulic acid, which causes kidney injury. Puberulic acid was first chemically recognized in 1931 [S1] and has only been studied as an antimalarial troponoid, with no mention of its effects on the human body, including renal toxicity [S2].

pmc-11637661.title: Hepatobiliary scintigraphy of bile excretion after endoscopic ultrasound-guided hepaticogastrostomy for malignant biliary obstruction: a retrospective study in Japan
pmc-11637661.creator: Masanori Yamada, Kazuo Hara, Shin Haba, Takamichi Kuwahara, Nozomi Okuno, Yasuhiro Kuraishi, Takafumi Yanaidani, Sho Ishikawa, Tsukasa Yasuda, Toshitaka Fukui
pmc-11637661.description: Background/AimsHepatobiliary scintigraphy (HBS) is used to evaluate bile excretion. This study aimed to evaluate biliary excretion during endoscopic ultrasound-guided hepaticogastrostomy (EUS-HGS) using HBS.MethodsWe retrospectively evaluated 78 consecutive patients with malignant extrahepatic biliary obstruction, who underwent HBS after EUS-HGS between April 2015 and July 2022.

pmc-11664690.title: Effect of Malnutrition in Operatively Treated Ankle Fractures for Insulin- and Non-Insulin-Dependent Diabetic Patients
pmc-11664690.creator: Terence Y Ng, Phillips Geoffrey
pmc-11664690.description: Category:Trauma; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:It has been widely demonstrated that patients with insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus (IDDM) have higher complication rates compared to non-insulin dependent diabetic patients (NIDDM) after operative treatment of ankle fractures. However, there is a paucity of research comparing the preoperative nutritional status of IDDM versus NDDM patients, as a modifiable preoperative risk factor.

pmc-11680245.title: Phenotypic Differences Between the Epidemic Strains of Vesicular Stomatitis Virus Serotype Indiana 98COE and IN0919WYB2 Using an In-Vivo Pig (Sus scrofa) Model
pmc-11680245.creator: Kate Hole, Patrycja Sroga, Michelle Nebroski, Katherine Handel, Oliver Lung, Edward Spinard, Selene Zarate, Charles Nfon, Luis L Rodriguez, Shawn Babiuk, Chad Mire, Lauro Velazquez-Salinas, Charles E Rupprecht
pmc-11680245.description: During the past 25 years, vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) has produced multiple outbreaks in the US, resulting in the emergence of different viral lineages. Currently, very little is known about the pathogenesis of many of these lineages, thus limiting our understanding of the potential biological factors favoring each lineage in these outbreaks.

pmc-11714827.title: Significance of plasma biomarkers in predicting long‐term dementia risk in community dwellings: insights from machine learning approaches
pmc-11714827.creator: Zhenxu Xiao, Xiaowen Zhou, Qianhua Zhao, Yang Cao, Ding Ding
pmc-11714827.description: BackgroundThe role of plasma biomarkers for predicting incident dementia in the general population is still undetermined.MethodA total of 1857 baseline non‐demented older adults with follow‐ups within 10 years were included from a community‐based cohort. Consensus diagnoses of dementia and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) were based on clinical criteria.

pmc-12676328.title: Surfactant Ratio-Driven Modulation of Caffeine Loading and Release in Nigella sativa Oil Nanostructured Lipid Carriers
pmc-12676328.creator: Nindya Indah Damayanti, Nicholas M. H. Khong, Celine Valeria Liew, Romchat Chutoprapat
pmc-12676328.description: The delivery of hydrophilic actives such as caffeine through lipid-based topical carriers remains a challenge due to their poor affinity for lipophilic matrices and the barrier properties of the stratum corneum. This study investigated how the Tween 80/Span 20 surfactant ratio modulates interfacial organization, caffeine encapsulation, and release behavior of caffeine-loaded nanostructured lipid carriers (NLCs) formulated with Nigella sativa oil.

pmc-12705493.title: Cardiac Arrest Caused by Tracheal Intubation During Anesthesia Induction: A Case Report
pmc-12705493.creator: Haiyun Gu, Haikun Zhang, Le Cao, Jinxiang Yu, Tao Zhao
pmc-12705493.description: Cardiac arrest during peri‐intubation is rare, necessitating timely identification of its cause and the implementation of precise diagnostic and therapeutic interventions. The purpose of the report is to pay attention to peri‐intubation cardiac arrest and to advocate for proactive management strategies to avert severe outcomes.

pmc-12738075.title: Vascularization of Human Pancreatic Islets With Adaptive Endothelial Cells for In Vitro Analysis and In Vivo Transplantation
pmc-12738075.creator: Ge Li, Rebecca Craig-Schapiro, Ahsan Uddin, Shahin Rafii
pmc-12738075.description: The pancreatic islet, the only type of tissue that secretes insulin in response to elevated blood glucose, plays a vital role in diabetes development and treatment. While various islet vascularization strategies have been developed, they have been hindered by major limitations such as relying on pre-patterning and the inability to span long distances.

pmc-12785695.title: Association of Galectin-9 Soluble Immune Checkpoint with Clinical Prognostic Markers in Patients with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
pmc-12785695.creator: Aviwe Ntsethe, Phiwayinkosi Vusi Dludla, Bongani Brian Nkambule
pmc-12785695.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) is a heterogenous disease, with varied clinical outcomes. Multiplex assays used to measure soluble immune checkpoints offer a less laborious method of monitoring patients with CLL, but none of these panels have been validated.

pmc-13226193.title: Neurosurgical intervention versus conservative management in older adults with traumatic brain injury: a protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13226193.creator: Ravi Shankar, Yuen Ling Hue, Karen Sui Geok Chua
pmc-13226193.description: BackgroundTraumatic brain injury in older adults represents a serious public health challenge with complex management decisions. The aging population exhibits distinct pathophysiological responses to brain injury, altered recovery trajectories, and increased vulnerability to both surgical and medical complications. Decision-making regarding neurosurgical intervention versus conservative management remains contentious, with limited high-quality evidence specific to older populations.

pmc-13673058.title: Neuron‐Derived Vesicular circMagi1 Restrains Vascular Repair After Ischemic Stroke by Promoting TRIM65‐Mediated ANXA2 Degradation
pmc-13673058.creator: Youkun Bi, Qun Liu, Baohua Zou, Wenyuan Wang, Xinlong Qiao, Lin Gao, Chaoxu Miao, Ningning Huang, Shuqing Tang, Rui Guo, Changqing Zeng, Ce Jia, Yuanchao Xue, Xuejun Guo, Jianjun Chen, Huiwen Wang, Guangju Ji
pmc-13673058.description: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) contribute to stroke pathogenesis, yet their intercellular functions within the ischemic neurovascular unit remain poorly defined. Profiling of plasma extracellular vesicles (EVs) revealed a higher abundance of circMagi1 in patients with acute ischemic stroke compared with healthy controls.
